deepDive.markdownContent:
## Sliding Window Maximum Patterns

This deep dive walks through when to apply **Sliding Window Maximum Patterns**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.

caseStudy.impact: Lower MTTR and fewer customer-impacting regressions
